description: This file contains abstract test class 'AbstractSSLContextTest' for testing SSL/TLS context creation and behavior in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.internal.ssl' package. It includes setup for different SSL contexts, various test cases for SSL handshake and hostname verification, and server socket management.

classes.name: AbstractSSLContextTest
classes.description: Abstract base class providing SSL context creation and test methods for SSL handshake, hostname verification, and client/server SSL communication.

methods.name: createSSLContext
methods.description: Abstract method to create SSLContext with specified trusted certificates, hostname, and credentials.

methods.name: createAcceptAnySSLContext
methods.description: Abstract method to create SSLContext that accepts any SSL certificate.

methods.name: trustdServerSignedByUntrustedCA
methods.description: Test that verifies distrust of server signed by untrusted CA.

methods.name: distrustUnsignedServerHostname
methods.description: Test that verifies distrust of server with unsigned hostname.

methods.name: distrustUnsignedServerIp
methods.description: Test that verifies distrust of server with unsigned IP addresses.

methods.name: trustUnsignedHostnameOrIpByExactCertificateMatch
methods.description: Test that verifies trust when hostname/IP matches server certificate exactly.

methods.name: trustSignedServerDNSName
methods.description: Test that verifies trust of signed server DNS name.

methods.name: distrustSignedServerCNIfSANExist
methods.description: Test that verifies distrust of server certificate's CN if SAN exists, following RFC rules.

methods.name: trustSignedServerIp
methods.description: Test that verifies trust of signed server IP addresses.

methods.name: distrustSelfSignedClient
methods.description: Test that verifies distrust of a self-signed client certificate.

methods.name: trustSignedClient
methods.description: Test that verifies trust of a signed client certificate.

methods.name: trustEverybodyWithAcceptAnyTrustManager
methods.description: Test that verifies connection acceptance when using a trust-all SSL context.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Helper method to start a SSL server socket with optional client authentication and credentials.
